name: Pick readings
func:
const wanted = {
  // system summary
  'system/0/Ac/Grid/L1/Power': 'grid_power_w',
  'system/0/Ac/Consumption/L1/Power': 'consumption_power_w',
  'system/0/Ac/ConsumptionOnInput/L1/Power': 'consumption_on_input_w',
  'system/0/Ac/ConsumptionOnOutput/L1/Power': 'consumption_on_output_w',
  'system/0/Dc/Pv/Power': 'pv_power_w',
  'system/0/Dc/Battery/Power': 'battery_power_w',
  'system/0/Dc/Battery/Soc': 'battery_soc_pct',
  'system/0/Dc/Battery/Voltage': 'battery_voltage_v',
  'system/0/Dc/Battery/Current': 'battery_current_a',
  'system/0/Dc/Battery/Temperature': 'battery_temp_c',
  'system/0/Dc/Battery/TimeToGo': 'battery_time_to_go_s',
  'system/0/Ac/ActiveIn/Source': 'active_in_source',
  'system/0/SystemState/State': 'system_state',
  'system/0/SystemState/LowSoc': 'flag_low_soc',
  'system/0/SystemState/SlowCharge': 'flag_slow_charge',
  'system/0/SystemState/ChargeDisabled': 'flag_charge_disabled',
  'system/0/SystemState/DischargeDisabled': 'flag_discharge_disabled',
  'system/0/SystemState/BatteryLife': 'flag_batterylife',
  'system/0/Control/ScheduledCharge': 'scheduled_charge_active',

  // grid meter (EM112)
  'grid/30/Ac/Energy/Forward': 'grid_import_kwh',
  'grid/30/Ac/Energy/Reverse': 'grid_export_kwh',
  'grid/30/Ac/L1/Voltage': 'grid_voltage_v',
  'grid/30/Ac/L1/Current': 'grid_current_a',
  'grid/30/Ac/L1/PowerFactor': 'grid_power_factor',
  'grid/30/Ac/Frequency': 'grid_frequency_hz',

  // inverter/charger (EasySolar)
  'vebus/275/State': 'vebus_state',
  'vebus/275/Ac/ActiveIn/L1/P': 'vebus_ac_in_power_w',
  'vebus/275/Ac/Out/L1/P': 'vebus_ac_out_power_w',
  'vebus/275/Dc/0/Power': 'vebus_dc_power_w',
  'vebus/275/Dc/0/Temperature': 'vebus_temp_c',
  'vebus/275/Alarms/L1/Overload': 'vebus_alarm_overload',
  'vebus/275/Alarms/L1/HighTemperature': 'vebus_alarm_high_temp',

  // battery BMS
  'battery/512/Soc': 'bms_soc_pct',
  'battery/512/Soh': 'bms_soh_pct',
  'battery/512/Info/MaxChargeCurrent': 'bms_ccl_a',
  'battery/512/Info/MaxDischargeCurrent': 'bms_dcl_a',
  'battery/512/Info/MaxChargeVoltage': 'bms_cvl_v',
  'battery/512/System/MinCellVoltage': 'bms_cell_v_min',
  'battery/512/System/MaxCellVoltage': 'bms_cell_v_max',
  'battery/512/System/MinCellTemperature': 'bms_cell_temp_min',
  'battery/512/System/MaxCellTemperature': 'bms_cell_temp_max',
  'battery/512/System/NrOfModulesOnline': 'bms_modules_online',
  'battery/512/System/NrOfModulesBlockingCharge': 'bms_modules_blocking_charge',
  'battery/512/System/NrOfModulesBlockingDischarge': 'bms_modules_blocking_discharge',
  'battery/512/Alarms/CellImbalance': 'bms_alarm_cell_imbalance',
  'battery/512/Alarms/LowChargeTemperature': 'bms_alarm_low_charge_temp',
  'battery/512/Alarms/ChargeBlocked': 'bms_alarm_charge_blocked',
  'battery/512/Alarms/DischargeBlocked': 'bms_alarm_discharge_blocked',
  'battery/512/Alarms/InternalFailure': 'bms_alarm_internal_failure',

  // solar charger (MPPT)
  'solarcharger/273/Pv/V': 'pv_voltage_v',
  'solarcharger/273/Yield/Power': 'mppt_power_w',
  'solarcharger/273/Yield/System': 'pv_yield_total_kwh',
  'solarcharger/273/History/Daily/0/Yield': 'pv_yield_today_kwh',
  'solarcharger/273/MppOperationMode': 'mppt_mode',
  'solarcharger/273/State': 'mppt_state',
  'solarcharger/273/ErrorCode': 'mppt_error'
};
const path = msg.topic.split('/').slice(2).join('/');
const name = wanted[path];
if (!name || typeof msg.payload.value !== 'number') return null;
msg.topic = name;
msg.payload = msg.payload.value;
return msg;

SELECT now(), 'victron', unnest($1::text[]), unnest($2::double precision[]);
